prompt: automake TESTS program exit status result ignored
answer:
For a normal Automake `TESTS` entry, the program’s exit status is used:

- Exit status `0`: test passes.
- Any nonzero status: test fails.
- Exit status `77`: test is skipped, so its result is ignored when counting failures and successes.  
  Source: [Automake testing documentation](https://www.gnu.org.cach3.com/software/automake/manual/html_node/Generalities-about-Testing.html), [Autobook](https://www.sourceware.org/autobook/autobook/autobook_42.html).

If the TAP driver is being used, a nonzero producer exit status is checked unless its `ignore_exit` setting is enabled. A TAP `Bail out!` also causes the driver to ignore the producer’s nonzero exit status.  
Source: [Automake `tap-driver.sh`](https://gnu.googlesource.com/automake/+/refs/tags/v1.13.1/lib/tap-driver.sh).
